%20Matching%20Anki%27s%20own%20selector%20shape%0A%20%20%20%28element%20%2B%20class%29%20is%20what%20actually%20wins%20the%20tie%20-%20the%20same%20kind%20of%20fix%0A%20%20%20_amgi-loop.css%20already%20applies%20to%20%60button.amgi-btn%60%20for%20an%20unrelated%0A%20%20%20collision%20with%20Anki%27s%20%60.fancy%20button%60%20rule%20-%20not%20%60%21important%60%2C%20and%20this%0A%20%20%20stylesheet%20loads%20after%20reviewer.css%27s%20in%20the%20document%2C%20so%20an%0A%20%20%20equal-specificity%20tie%20also%20resolves%20in%20our%20favour.%20%2A%2F%0Abody.card%20%7B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20An%20editorial%20serif%2C%20on%20every%20line%20of%20the%20card%20-%20the%20owner%27s%20call%20after%0A%20%20%20%20%20comparing%20four%20candidates%20live%20%28font%200%2FA%2FB%2FC%2C%20see%20the%20design%20pass%20this%0A%20%20%20%20%20followed%29%3A%20%22font%20B%20is%20best%20for%20the%20korean%20text%20and%20the%20other%20language%0A%20%20%20%20%20text.%22%20That%20was%20scoped%20to%20the%20answer%20side%27s%20content%20%28the%20target%20phrase%0A%20%20%20%20%20and%20its%20gloss%29%2C%20but%20the%20follow-up%20review%20made%20the%20real%20complaint%20plain%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%22the%20text%20of%20the%20amgi%20itself%22%20-%20the%20status%20line%2C%20the%20replay%20buttons%2C%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20reveal%20button%2C%20any%20note%20-%20was%20what%20read%20as%20generic%2C%20%22too%20much%20like%20an%0A%20%20%20%20%20Amazon%20product%22%2C%20not%20the%20content%20it%20sits%20around.%20Rather%20than%20pairing%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20second%2C%20%22characterful%22%20chrome%20typeface%20against%20the%20content%20serif%20%28the%0A%20%20%20%20%20classic%20pairing%2C%20and%20a%20real%20option%20-%20see%20the%20alternative%20screenshots%0A%20%20%20%20%20this%20pass%20also%20produced%29%2C%20this%20sets%20ONE%20font-family%20here%2C%20on%20body.card%0A%20%20%20%20%20itself%2C%20so%20every%20element%20on%20the%20card%20inherits%20it%3A%20the%20content%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28.amgi-text-target%2F-cue%2F-notes%29%20and%20the%20chrome%20%28.amgi-status%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20button.amgi-btn%20via%20its%20own%20%60font%3A%20inherit%60%2C%20.amgi-note%29%20end%20up%20in%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20same%20family%20by%20construction%2C%20not%20by%20two%20rules%20that%20could%20drift%20apart.%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20chrome%20already%20sits%20smaller%20and%20quieter%20than%20the%20content%20-%20see%0A%20%20%20%20%20.amgi-status%27s%201.3rem%2F600%20vs%20.amgi-text-target%27s%201.85rem%2F700%2C%20and%0A%20%20%20%20%20button%2F.amgi-note%27s%20own%20smaller%20sizes%20plus%20--amgi-secondary-opacity%20-%0A%20%20%20%20%20so%20%22one%20coherent%20editorial%20object%20where%20the%20chrome%20is%20quieter%2C%20not%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20second%20face%22%20falls%20out%20of%20sizing%20that%20already%20existed%2C%20without%20gambling%0A%20%20%20%20%20a%20second%20font%27s%20availability%20across%20platforms%20on%20top%20of%20it.%20A%0A%20%20%20%20%20characterful%20sans%20is%20a%20real%20pairing%20%28Trebuchet%20MS%2FAvenir%20Next%2C%20see%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20alternative%20shots%29%20but%20degrades%20to%20the%20same%20generic%20system%20sans%20this%0A%20%20%20%20%20fixed%20on%20Windows%2FLinux%20where%20neither%20ships%2C%20which%20reintroduces%20the%20exact%0A%20%20%20%20%20complaint%20on%20every%20platform%20but%20macOS%3B%20one%20serif%20stack%20does%20not%20have%0A%20%20%20%20%20that%20failure%20mode.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20stack%20itself%3A%20%60ui-serif%60%20first%20%28Safari%20and%20Chromium%20both%20resolve%0A%20%20%20%20%20this%20to%20the%20platform%27s%20own%20serif%20UI%20font%20-%20New%20York-family%20on%20recent%0A%20%20%20%20%20macOS%29%2C%20then%20Latin%20serif%20fallbacks%20for%20the%20gloss%2Fchrome%20text%20alone%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28Georgia%2FCambria%2FTimes%20New%20Roman%20carry%20no%20CJK%20glyphs%2C%20so%20the%20browser%0A%20%20%20%20%20skips%20them%20for%20Korean%20or%20Japanese%20characters%20specifically%20and%20keeps%0A%20%20%20%20%20them%20only%20for%20English%29%2C%20then%20the%20CJK-capable%20serifs%20in%20the%20order%20most%0A%20%20%20%20%20likely%20to%20find%20one%20actually%20installed.%20%60Language%60%20%28see%20anki%2FREADME.md%27s%0A%20%20%20%20%20field%20table%29%20is%20not%20Korean-only%20-%20%60ja%60%20is%20a%20documented%20value%20too%20-%20so%0A%20%20%20%20%20this%20covers%20both%20scripts%2C%20and%20they%20get%20genuinely%20different%20treatment%0A%20%20%20%20%20because%20their%20platforms%20do%3A%20Yu%20Mincho%20ships%20on%20Windows%208.1%2B%20as%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20modern%2C%20elegant%20Japanese%20serif%20%28Microsoft%27s%20own%20reaction%20to%20MS%20Mincho%0A%20%20%20%20%20looking%20dated%29%2C%20so%20a%20Japanese%20card%20on%20stock%20Windows%20already%20lands%0A%20%20%20%20%20somewhere%20good.%20Korean%20has%20no%20equivalent%20-%20Microsoft%20has%20never%20shipped%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20newer%20serif%20for%20Hangul%20the%20way%20it%20shipped%20Yu%20Mincho%20for%20Japanese%20-%20so%0A%20%20%20%20%20Batang%20%28dated%2C%20the%20previous%20pass%27s%20own%20complaint%29%20or%20Gungsuh%20%28more%0A%20%20%20%20%20brush-influenced%2C%20not%20less%20dated%29%20are%20the%20only%20two%20serif%20Hangul%20faces%0A%20%20%20%20%20Windows%20guarantees%2C%20and%20that%20cannot%20be%20fixed%20without%20shipping%20a%20font%0A%20%20%20%20%20file%2C%20which%20this%20stack%20deliberately%20does%20not%20do%20%28no%20%40font-face%2C%20no%0A%20%20%20%20%20downloaded%20weight%20to%20flag%20a%20licence%20for%29.%20What%20this%20ordering%20can%0A%20%20%20%20%20actually%20improve%20is%20everything%20upstream%20of%20that%20floor%3A%20Nanum%20Myeongjo%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28ships%20with%20many%20Korean-locale%20Office%20installs%20and%20Linux%20CJK%20font%0A%20%20%20%20%20packages%2C%20and%20is%20a%20genuinely%20modern%20face%29%20and%20Hiragino%20Mincho%20ProN%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28macOS%27s%20own%20Japanese%20serif%2C%20redundant%20with%20%60ui-serif%60%20there%20but%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20direct-name%20fallback%20for%20engines%20that%20don%27t%20resolve%20the%20generic%20one%29%0A%20%20%20%20%20both%20come%20before%20the%20Noto%20Serif%20KR%2FJP%2FCJK%20KR%2FCJK%20JP%20family%20%28ChromeOS%20and%0A%20%20%20%20%20most%20Linux%20CJK%20bundles%29%2C%20which%20in%20turn%20comes%20before%20AppleMyungjo%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28macOS%2C%20likewise%20redundant%20with%20%60ui-serif%60%29%20and%20Batang%2FMS%20Mincho%20last%20of%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20named%20fonts%20-%20so%20any%20platform%20that%20has%20something%20better%20than%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20Windows%20floor%20installed%20gets%20it%2C%20and%20a%20bare%20Windows%20box%20degrades%20no%0A%20%20%20%20%20worse%20than%20it%20already%20would%20have.%20Generic%20%60serif%60%20closes%20the%20stack%20for%0A%20%20%20%20%20whatever%20is%20left.%20Contrast%20is%20unaffected%20by%20any%20of%20this%3A%20WCAG%27s%20ratio%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20a%20function%20of%20the%20two%20colours%20only%2C%20and%20none%20changed%20here%20-%20see%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20numbers%20already%20recorded%20below%20and%20in%20_amgi-loop.css%27s%20own%20comment.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20SUPERSEDED%2C%20deliberately%3A%20the%20long%20comment%20above%20records%20why%20this%20card%0A%20%20%20%20%20was%20set%20in%20an%20editorial%20serif%2C%20and%20that%20reasoning%20was%20sound%20at%20the%20time.%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20owner%20overturned%20it%20at%20the%20end%20of%20the%20treatment%20review%2C%20having%20seen%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20same%20card%20in%20four%20type%20systems%20side%20by%20side%3A%20%22lets%20lock%20in%20plain%0A%20%20%20%20%20anki%20font%22.%20So%20this%20is%20Anki%27s%20own%20default%20stack%2C%20which%20is%20what%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20reviewer%20ships%20when%20a%20note%20type%20sets%20nothing%20at%20all.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20Worth%20keeping%20the%20trade-off%20on%20record%20rather%20than%20just%20the%20outcome.%20The%0A%20%20%20%20%20serif%20was%20chosen%20to%20stop%20the%20chrome%20reading%20as%20generic%3B%20what%20the%20side%20by%0A%20%20%20%20%20side%20showed%20is%20that%20Anki%27s%20own%20face%20reads%20as%20%2Anative%2A%20rather%20than%20as%0A%20%20%20%20%20generic%2C%20because%20it%20is%20the%20face%20every%20other%20card%20in%20the%20collection%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20already%20in.%20A%20deck%20that%20looks%20like%20it%20belongs%20in%20Anki%20beats%20a%20deck%20that%0A%20%20%20%20%20looks%20designed%2C%20when%20the%20learner%20is%20going%20to%20see%20thirty%20of%20them%20in%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20row.%20It%20also%20removes%20the%20whole%20Hangul-serif%20problem%20the%20stack%20above%0A%20%20%20%20%20spends%20a%20paragraph%20on%3A%20Arial%20and%20Helvetica%20have%20no%20CJK%20coverage%2C%20so%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20browser%20falls%20through%20to%20whatever%20the%20platform%27s%20own%20UI%20face%20is%20for%0A%20%20%20%20%20Korean%20and%20Japanese%20-%20which%20is%20exactly%20what%20Anki%20itself%20does%2C%20and%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20guaranteed%20to%20be%20installed%20and%20current%2C%20unlike%20Batang.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20font-family%3A%20Arial%2C%20%22Helvetica%20Neue%22%2C%20Helvetica%2C%20sans-serif%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20Deliberately%20no%20font-size%20here%20any%20more%3A%20every%20visible%20size%20in%0A%20%20%20%20%20_amgi-loop.css%20is%20already%20in%20rem%2C%20which%20resolves%20against%20Anki%27s%20own%20html%0A%20%20%20%20%20root%20%28webview.py%20sets%20that%20from%20the%20Qt%20system%20font%20when%20%22use%20system%20font%0A%20%20%20%20%20size%22%20is%20on%29%2C%20not%20against%20.card.%20A%20fixed%20px%20size%20on%20.card%20did%20nothing%0A%20%20%20%20%20but%20drift%20out%20of%20step%20with%20that%20setting%20while%20looking%20load-bearing.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20text-align%3A%20center%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20amgi%27s%20card%20is%20dark%20unconditionally%20now%20-%20the%20owner%27s%20call%20after%20seeing%0A%20%20%20%20%20it%20run%2C%20not%20a%20rendering%20accident.%20It%20used%20to%20switch%20on%20Anki%27s%20own%0A%20%20%20%20%20.nightMode%2F.night_mode%20class%20%28Anki%20puts%20that%20on%20this%20same%20element%2C%20not%0A%20%20%20%20%20an%20ancestor%20-%20qt%2Faqt%2Freviewer.py%2C%20body_class%29%3B%20that%20class%20check%2C%20and%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20light-theme%20colours%20it%20used%20to%20fall%20back%20to%2C%20are%20gone%2C%20because%20there%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20no%20longer%20a%20second%20treatment%20for%20it%20to%20pick%20between.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%230b0d10%2C%20not%20the%20earlier%20%23202429%3A%20the%20owner%20asked%20for%20meaningfully%0A%20%20%20%20%20darker%2C%20near-black%20rather%20than%20one%20shade%20down%2C%20once%20he%20saw%20the%20lighter%0A%20%20%20%20%20charcoal%20live.%20Contrast%20only%20goes%20up%20as%20a%20background%20gets%20darker%20%28WCAG%27s%0A%20%20%20%20%20ratio%20is%20monotonic%20in%20the%20darker%20side%27s%20luminance%29%2C%20so%20every%20colour%0A%20%20%20%20%20tuned%20against%20%23202429%20already%20clears%20its%20bar%20by%20more%20room%20now%2C%20not%0A%20%20%20%20%20less%20-%20recomputed%20rather%20than%20assumed%3A%20this%20text%20against%20this%0A%20%20%20%20%20background%20is%2016.40%3A1%20%28WCAG%20AA%20needs%20%3E%3D4.5%3A1%2C%20was%2013.15%3A1%20against%0A%20%20%20%20%20%23202429%29%20-%20see%20_amgi-loop.css%20for%20the%20rest%20of%20the%20palette%2C%20recomputed%0A%20%20%20%20%20against%20this%20same%20background.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20Anki%27s%20own%20chrome%20around%20the%20card%20-%20the%20toolbar%20above%2C%20the%20answer%20bar%0A%20%20%20%20%20below%20-%20is%20not%20part%20of%20this%20template%20and%20stays%20in%20whatever%20theme%20Anki%0A%20%20%20%20%20itself%20is%20running.%20In%20Anki%27s%20LIGHT%20theme%20that%20puts%20a%20dark%20box%20inside%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20light%20frame%2C%20so%20--amgi-card-margin%20below%20is%20not%20decorative%3A%20without%20it%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20card%27s%20own%20edges%20are%20exactly%20the%20window%27s%20edges%2C%20and%20a%20colour%20that%0A%20%20%20%20%20stops%20dead%20at%20the%20edge%20of%20the%20screen%20reads%20as%20a%20bug%2C%20not%20a%20choice.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20hairline%20border%20this%20rule%20used%20to%20add%20is%20gone%20-%20the%20owner%27s%20call%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20on%20sight%2C%20once%20the%20card%20was%20actually%20near-black%20rather%20than%20a%20lighter%0A%20%20%20%20%20charcoal%3A%20a%201px%20rgba%28255%2C255%2C255%2C0.08%29%20edge%20that%20was%20barely%20there%0A%20%20%20%20%20against%20%23202429%20became%20a%20visible%20outline%20against%20%230b0d10%2C%20and%20it%20read%0A%20%20%20%20%20as%20a%20frame%20around%20the%20card%20rather%20than%20the%20card%20itself.%20Margin%2C%20radius%0A%20%20%20%20%20and%20shadow%20stay%3A%20the%20margin%20is%20what%20keeps%20the%20card%20off%20the%20window%27s%20own%0A%20%20%20%20%20edges%20%28needed%20regardless%20of%20theme%2C%20see%20above%29%2C%20the%20radius%20is%20what%0A%20%20%20%20%20keeps%20the%20corners%20from%20reading%20as%20a%20mistake%20at%20that%20margin%2C%20and%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20shadow%20is%20what%20still%20separates%20the%20panel%20from%20Anki%27s%20own%20light-theme%0A%20%20%20%20%20background%20without%20drawing%20a%20line%20to%20do%20it%20-%20a%20shadow%20reads%20as%20depth%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20a%20border%20reads%20as%20a%20frame%2C%20and%20depth%20was%20the%20only%20one%20of%20the%20two%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20owner%20wanted.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20color%3A%20%23e8ecf1%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20Black%2C%20not%20the%20near-black%20%230b0d10%20this%20sat%20at%3A%20the%20owner%27s%20call%20on%0A%20%20%20%20%20seeing%20the%20card%20next%20to%20Anki%27s%20own%20dark%20chrome%20%28%22make%20the%20background%0A%20%20%20%20%20actually%20black%22%29.%20Every%20contrast%20figure%20recorded%20in%20this%20file%20and%20in%0A%20%20%20%20%20_amgi-loop.css%20was%20computed%20against%20%230b0d10%20and%20can%20only%20have%20gone%20UP%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20since%20contrast%20is%20a%20function%20of%20the%20two%20luminances%20and%20this%20background%27s%0A%20%20%20%20%20just%20went%20to%20its%20floor%20-%20so%20none%20of%20them%20needed%20rechecking%20to%20stay%0A%20%20%20%20%20valid%2C%20and%20none%20were%20rewritten%20to%20claim%20otherwise.%20The%20one%20thing%20that%0A%20%20%20%20%20genuinely%20changes%20is%20the%20card%27s%20edge%3A%20against%20a%20true%20black%20the%20margin%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20radius%20and%20shadow%20below%20do%20more%20work%2C%20not%20less%2C%20because%20the%20card%20can%20no%0A%20%20%20%20%20longer%20be%20told%20from%20an%20unlit%20region%20of%20the%20window%20by%20its%20fill%20alone.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20background%3A%20%23000%3B%0A%20%20--amgi-card-margin%3A%200.75rem%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20No%20margin%20along%20the%20bottom%2C%20and%20square%20corners%20there.%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20visualizer%20is%20a%20band%20standing%20on%20the%20foot%20of%20the%20card%2C%20and%20the%20point%0A%20%20%20%20%20of%20it%20is%20that%20it%20stands%20on%20Anki%27s%20answer%20bar%20rather%20than%20floating%20above%0A%20%20%20%20%20it%20-%20so%20a%20margin%20between%20the%20two%20is%20a%20gap%20in%20the%20one%20place%20the%20design%0A%20%20%20%20%20does%20not%20want%20one.%20Top%20and%20sides%20keep%20theirs%3A%20those%20edges%20are%20what%20make%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20card%20read%20as%20a%20card%20against%20Anki%27s%20own%20chrome%2C%20and%20nothing%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20touching%20them.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20margin%3A%20var%28--amgi-card-margin%29%20var%28--amgi-card-margin%29%200%3B%0A%20%20border-radius%3A%201rem%201rem%200%200%3B%0A%20%20box-shadow%3A%200%2012px%2028px%20rgba%280%2C%200%2C%200%2C%200.35%29%3B%0A%7D%0A %2F%2A%20amgi%20Listening%20-%20Styling.%0A%20%20%20Paste%20this%20into%20Cards...%20%3E%20Styling%20for%20the%20%22amgi%20Listening%22%20note%20type.%0A%0A%20%20%20Everything%20else%20lives%20in%20_amgi-loop.css%20in%20the%20media%20folder%2C%20so%20the%20look%20can%0A%20%20%20be%20updated%20by%20replacing%20one%20file%20instead%20of%20re-pasting%20the%20note%20type.%20Anki%0A%20%20%20tracks%20the%20quoted%20underscore%20filename%20as%20a%20used%20media%20file%0A%20%20%20%28rslib%2Fsrc%2Ftext.rs%2C%20UNDERSCORED_CSS_IMPORTS%29%2C%20and%20never%20reports%20an%0A%20%20%20underscore-prefixed%20file%20as%20unused%20%28rslib%2Fsrc%2Fmedia%2Fcheck.rs%29.%20%2A%2F%0A%0A%40import%20url%28%22_amgi-loop.css%22%29%3B%0A%0A%2F%2A%20%60body.card%60%2C%20not%20%60.card%60%3A%20confirmed%20live%20in%20real%20Anki%20%2826.09.2%2C%20dark%20Qt%0A%20%20%20theme%29%20that%20Anki%27s%20own%20reviewer.css%20ships%20%60body.nightMode%20%7B%20background-color%3A%0A%20%20%20var%28--canvas%29%3B%20color%3A%20var%28--fg%29%3B%20%7D%60%2C%20and%20an%20element-plus-class%20selector%0A%20%20%20%28specificity%200%2C1%2C1%29%20outranks%20a%20single%20class%20selector%20%280%2C1%2C0%29%20regardless%20of%0A%20%20%20which%20stylesheet%20loads%20second%20-%20so%20on%20a%20body%20carrying%20Anki%27s%20own%0A%20%20%20%22nightMode%22%20class%20%28every%20dark-themed%20Anki%20client%3B%20qt%2Faqt%2Freviewer.py%2C%0A%20%20%20body_class%29%2C%20%60.card%60%27s%20own%20background%20and%20color%20NEVER%20WON%2C%20silently%2C%0A%20%20%20since%20the%20very%20first%20%22dark%20unconditionally%22%20pass%3A%20the%20card%20rendered%0A%20%20%20Anki%27s%20own%20night-canvas%20grey%20%28%232c2c2c%29%20instead%20of%20amgi%27s%20colour%2C%20and%0A%20%20%20nobody%20caught%20it%20because%20the%20only%20%22confirmed%20live%22%20check%20on%20record%20for%0A%20%20%20this%20rule%20was%20run%20in%20Anki%27s%20LIGHT%20theme%2C%20where%20body%20has%20no%20%22nightMode%22%0A%20%20%20class%20and%20the%20conflict%20cannot%20occur.%20Matching%20Anki%27s%20own%20selector%20shape%0A%20%20%20%28element%20%2B%20class%29%20is%20what%20actually%20wins%20the%20tie%20-%20the%20same%20kind%20of%20fix%0A%20%20%20_amgi-loop.css%20already%20applies%20to%20%60button.amgi-btn%60%20for%20an%20unrelated%0A%20%20%20collision%20with%20Anki%27s%20%60.fancy%20button%60%20rule%20-%20not%20%60%21important%60%2C%20and%20this%0A%20%20%20stylesheet%20loads%20after%20reviewer.css%27s%20in%20the%20document%2C%20so%20an%0A%20%20%20equal-specificity%20tie%20also%20resolves%20in%20our%20favour.%20%2A%2F%0Abody.card%20%7B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20An%20editorial%20serif%2C%20on%20every%20line%20of%20the%20card%20-%20the%20owner%27s%20call%20after%0A%20%20%20%20%20comparing%20four%20candidates%20live%20%28font%200%2FA%2FB%2FC%2C%20see%20the%20design%20pass%20this%0A%20%20%20%20%20followed%29%3A%20%22font%20B%20is%20best%20for%20the%20korean%20text%20and%20the%20other%20language%0A%20%20%20%20%20text.%22%20That%20was%20scoped%20to%20the%20answer%20side%27s%20content%20%28the%20target%20phrase%0A%20%20%20%20%20and%20its%20gloss%29%2C%20but%20the%20follow-up%20review%20made%20the%20real%20complaint%20plain%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%22the%20text%20of%20the%20amgi%20itself%22%20-%20the%20status%20line%2C%20the%20replay%20buttons%2C%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20reveal%20button%2C%20any%20note%20-%20was%20what%20read%20as%20generic%2C%20%22too%20much%20like%20an%0A%20%20%20%20%20Amazon%20product%22%2C%20not%20the%20content%20it%20sits%20around.%20Rather%20than%20pairing%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20second%2C%20%22characterful%22%20chrome%20typeface%20against%20the%20content%20serif%20%28the%0A%20%20%20%20%20classic%20pairing%2C%20and%20a%20real%20option%20-%20see%20the%20alternative%20screenshots%0A%20%20%20%20%20this%20pass%20also%20produced%29%2C%20this%20sets%20ONE%20font-family%20here%2C%20on%20body.card%0A%20%20%20%20%20itself%2C%20so%20every%20element%20on%20the%20card%20inherits%20it%3A%20the%20content%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28.amgi-text-target%2F-cue%2F-notes%29%20and%20the%20chrome%20%28.amgi-status%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20button.amgi-btn%20via%20its%20own%20%60font%3A%20inherit%60%2C%20.amgi-note%29%20end%20up%20in%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20same%20family%20by%20construction%2C%20not%20by%20two%20rules%20that%20could%20drift%20apart.%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20chrome%20already%20sits%20smaller%20and%20quieter%20than%20the%20content%20-%20see%0A%20%20%20%20%20.amgi-status%27s%201.3rem%2F600%20vs%20.amgi-text-target%27s%201.85rem%2F700%2C%20and%0A%20%20%20%20%20button%2F.amgi-note%27s%20own%20smaller%20sizes%20plus%20--amgi-secondary-opacity%20-%0A%20%20%20%20%20so%20%22one%20coherent%20editorial%20object%20where%20the%20chrome%20is%20quieter%2C%20not%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20second%20face%22%20falls%20out%20of%20sizing%20that%20already%20existed%2C%20without%20gambling%0A%20%20%20%20%20a%20second%20font%27s%20availability%20across%20platforms%20on%20top%20of%20it.%20A%0A%20%20%20%20%20characterful%20sans%20is%20a%20real%20pairing%20%28Trebuchet%20MS%2FAvenir%20Next%2C%20see%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20alternative%20shots%29%20but%20degrades%20to%20the%20same%20generic%20system%20sans%20this%0A%20%20%20%20%20fixed%20on%20Windows%2FLinux%20where%20neither%20ships%2C%20which%20reintroduces%20the%20exact%0A%20%20%20%20%20complaint%20on%20every%20platform%20but%20macOS%3B%20one%20serif%20stack%20does%20not%20have%0A%20%20%20%20%20that%20failure%20mode.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20stack%20itself%3A%20%60ui-serif%60%20first%20%28Safari%20and%20Chromium%20both%20resolve%0A%20%20%20%20%20this%20to%20the%20platform%27s%20own%20serif%20UI%20font%20-%20New%20York-family%20on%20recent%0A%20%20%20%20%20macOS%29%2C%20then%20Latin%20serif%20fallbacks%20for%20the%20gloss%2Fchrome%20text%20alone%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28Georgia%2FCambria%2FTimes%20New%20Roman%20carry%20no%20CJK%20glyphs%2C%20so%20the%20browser%0A%20%20%20%20%20skips%20them%20for%20Korean%20or%20Japanese%20characters%20specifically%20and%20keeps%0A%20%20%20%20%20them%20only%20for%20English%29%2C%20then%20the%20CJK-capable%20serifs%20in%20the%20order%20most%0A%20%20%20%20%20likely%20to%20find%20one%20actually%20installed.%20%60Language%60%20%28see%20anki%2FREADME.md%27s%0A%20%20%20%20%20field%20table%29%20is%20not%20Korean-only%20-%20%60ja%60%20is%20a%20documented%20value%20too%20-%20so%0A%20%20%20%20%20this%20covers%20both%20scripts%2C%20and%20they%20get%20genuinely%20different%20treatment%0A%20%20%20%20%20because%20their%20platforms%20do%3A%20Yu%20Mincho%20ships%20on%20Windows%208.1%2B%20as%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20modern%2C%20elegant%20Japanese%20serif%20%28Microsoft%27s%20own%20reaction%20to%20MS%20Mincho%0A%20%20%20%20%20looking%20dated%29%2C%20so%20a%20Japanese%20card%20on%20stock%20Windows%20already%20lands%0A%20%20%20%20%20somewhere%20good.%20Korean%20has%20no%20equivalent%20-%20Microsoft%20has%20never%20shipped%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20newer%20serif%20for%20Hangul%20the%20way%20it%20shipped%20Yu%20Mincho%20for%20Japanese%20-%20so%0A%20%20%20%20%20Batang%20%28dated%2C%20the%20previous%20pass%27s%20own%20complaint%29%20or%20Gungsuh%20%28more%0A%20%20%20%20%20brush-influenced%2C%20not%20less%20dated%29%20are%20the%20only%20two%20serif%20Hangul%20faces%0A%20%20%20%20%20Windows%20guarantees%2C%20and%20that%20cannot%20be%20fixed%20without%20shipping%20a%20font%0A%20%20%20%20%20file%2C%20which%20this%20stack%20deliberately%20does%20not%20do%20%28no%20%40font-face%2C%20no%0A%20%20%20%20%20downloaded%20weight%20to%20flag%20a%20licence%20for%29.%20What%20this%20ordering%20can%0A%20%20%20%20%20actually%20improve%20is%20everything%20upstream%20of%20that%20floor%3A%20Nanum%20Myeongjo%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28ships%20with%20many%20Korean-locale%20Office%20installs%20and%20Linux%20CJK%20font%0A%20%20%20%20%20packages%2C%20and%20is%20a%20genuinely%20modern%20face%29%20and%20Hiragino%20Mincho%20ProN%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28macOS%27s%20own%20Japanese%20serif%2C%20redundant%20with%20%60ui-serif%60%20there%20but%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20direct-name%20fallback%20for%20engines%20that%20don%27t%20resolve%20the%20generic%20one%29%0A%20%20%20%20%20both%20come%20before%20the%20Noto%20Serif%20KR%2FJP%2FCJK%20KR%2FCJK%20JP%20family%20%28ChromeOS%20and%0A%20%20%20%20%20most%20Linux%20CJK%20bundles%29%2C%20which%20in%20turn%20comes%20before%20AppleMyungjo%0A%20%20%20%20%20%28macOS%2C%20likewise%20redundant%20with%20%60ui-serif%60%29%20and%20Batang%2FMS%20Mincho%20last%20of%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20named%20fonts%20-%20so%20any%20platform%20that%20has%20something%20better%20than%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20Windows%20floor%20installed%20gets%20it%2C%20and%20a%20bare%20Windows%20box%20degrades%20no%0A%20%20%20%20%20worse%20than%20it%20already%20would%20have.%20Generic%20%60serif%60%20closes%20the%20stack%20for%0A%20%20%20%20%20whatever%20is%20left.%20Contrast%20is%20unaffected%20by%20any%20of%20this%3A%20WCAG%27s%20ratio%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20a%20function%20of%20the%20two%20colours%20only%2C%20and%20none%20changed%20here%20-%20see%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20numbers%20already%20recorded%20below%20and%20in%20_amgi-loop.css%27s%20own%20comment.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20SUPERSEDED%2C%20deliberately%3A%20the%20long%20comment%20above%20records%20why%20this%20card%0A%20%20%20%20%20was%20set%20in%20an%20editorial%20serif%2C%20and%20that%20reasoning%20was%20sound%20at%20the%20time.%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20owner%20overturned%20it%20at%20the%20end%20of%20the%20treatment%20review%2C%20having%20seen%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20same%20card%20in%20four%20type%20systems%20side%20by%20side%3A%20%22lets%20lock%20in%20plain%0A%20%20%20%20%20anki%20font%22.%20So%20this%20is%20Anki%27s%20own%20default%20stack%2C%20which%20is%20what%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20reviewer%20ships%20when%20a%20note%20type%20sets%20nothing%20at%20all.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20Worth%20keeping%20the%20trade-off%20on%20record%20rather%20than%20just%20the%20outcome.%20The%0A%20%20%20%20%20serif%20was%20chosen%20to%20stop%20the%20chrome%20reading%20as%20generic%3B%20what%20the%20side%20by%0A%20%20%20%20%20side%20showed%20is%20that%20Anki%27s%20own%20face%20reads%20as%20%2Anative%2A%20rather%20than%20as%0A%20%20%20%20%20generic%2C%20because%20it%20is%20the%20face%20every%20other%20card%20in%20the%20collection%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20already%20in.%20A%20deck%20that%20looks%20like%20it%20belongs%20in%20Anki%20beats%20a%20deck%20that%0A%20%20%20%20%20looks%20designed%2C%20when%20the%20learner%20is%20going%20to%20see%20thirty%20of%20them%20in%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20row.%20It%20also%20removes%20the%20whole%20Hangul-serif%20problem%20the%20stack%20above%0A%20%20%20%20%20spends%20a%20paragraph%20on%3A%20Arial%20and%20Helvetica%20have%20no%20CJK%20coverage%2C%20so%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20browser%20falls%20through%20to%20whatever%20the%20platform%27s%20own%20UI%20face%20is%20for%0A%20%20%20%20%20Korean%20and%20Japanese%20-%20which%20is%20exactly%20what%20Anki%20itself%20does%2C%20and%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20guaranteed%20to%20be%20installed%20and%20current%2C%20unlike%20Batang.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20font-family%3A%20Arial%2C%20%22Helvetica%20Neue%22%2C%20Helvetica%2C%20sans-serif%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20Deliberately%20no%20font-size%20here%20any%20more%3A%20every%20visible%20size%20in%0A%20%20%20%20%20_amgi-loop.css%20is%20already%20in%20rem%2C%20which%20resolves%20against%20Anki%27s%20own%20html%0A%20%20%20%20%20root%20%28webview.py%20sets%20that%20from%20the%20Qt%20system%20font%20when%20%22use%20system%20font%0A%20%20%20%20%20size%22%20is%20on%29%2C%20not%20against%20.card.%20A%20fixed%20px%20size%20on%20.card%20did%20nothing%0A%20%20%20%20%20but%20drift%20out%20of%20step%20with%20that%20setting%20while%20looking%20load-bearing.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20text-align%3A%20center%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20amgi%27s%20card%20is%20dark%20unconditionally%20now%20-%20the%20owner%27s%20call%20after%20seeing%0A%20%20%20%20%20it%20run%2C%20not%20a%20rendering%20accident.%20It%20used%20to%20switch%20on%20Anki%27s%20own%0A%20%20%20%20%20.nightMode%2F.night_mode%20class%20%28Anki%20puts%20that%20on%20this%20same%20element%2C%20not%0A%20%20%20%20%20an%20ancestor%20-%20qt%2Faqt%2Freviewer.py%2C%20body_class%29%3B%20that%20class%20check%2C%20and%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20light-theme%20colours%20it%20used%20to%20fall%20back%20to%2C%20are%20gone%2C%20because%20there%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20no%20longer%20a%20second%20treatment%20for%20it%20to%20pick%20between.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%230b0d10%2C%20not%20the%20earlier%20%23202429%3A%20the%20owner%20asked%20for%20meaningfully%0A%20%20%20%20%20darker%2C%20near-black%20rather%20than%20one%20shade%20down%2C%20once%20he%20saw%20the%20lighter%0A%20%20%20%20%20charcoal%20live.%20Contrast%20only%20goes%20up%20as%20a%20background%20gets%20darker%20%28WCAG%27s%0A%20%20%20%20%20ratio%20is%20monotonic%20in%20the%20darker%20side%27s%20luminance%29%2C%20so%20every%20colour%0A%20%20%20%20%20tuned%20against%20%23202429%20already%20clears%20its%20bar%20by%20more%20room%20now%2C%20not%0A%20%20%20%20%20less%20-%20recomputed%20rather%20than%20assumed%3A%20this%20text%20against%20this%0A%20%20%20%20%20background%20is%2016.40%3A1%20%28WCAG%20AA%20needs%20%3E%3D4.5%3A1%2C%20was%2013.15%3A1%20against%0A%20%20%20%20%20%23202429%29%20-%20see%20_amgi-loop.css%20for%20the%20rest%20of%20the%20palette%2C%20recomputed%0A%20%20%20%20%20against%20this%20same%20background.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20Anki%27s%20own%20chrome%20around%20the%20card%20-%20the%20toolbar%20above%2C%20the%20answer%20bar%0A%20%20%20%20%20below%20-%20is%20not%20part%20of%20this%20template%20and%20stays%20in%20whatever%20theme%20Anki%0A%20%20%20%20%20itself%20is%20running.%20In%20Anki%27s%20LIGHT%20theme%20that%20puts%20a%20dark%20box%20inside%20a%0A%20%20%20%20%20light%20frame%2C%20so%20--amgi-card-margin%20below%20is%20not%20decorative%3A%20without%20it%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20card%27s%20own%20edges%20are%20exactly%20the%20window%27s%20edges%2C%20and%20a%20colour%20that%0A%20%20%20%20%20stops%20dead%20at%20the%20edge%20of%20the%20screen%20reads%20as%20a%20bug%2C%20not%20a%20choice.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20hairline%20border%20this%20rule%20used%20to%20add%20is%20gone%20-%20the%20owner%27s%20call%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20on%20sight%2C%20once%20the%20card%20was%20actually%20near-black%20rather%20than%20a%20lighter%0A%20%20%20%20%20charcoal%3A%20a%201px%20rgba%28255%2C255%2C255%2C0.08%29%20edge%20that%20was%20barely%20there%0A%20%20%20%20%20against%20%23202429%20became%20a%20visible%20outline%20against%20%230b0d10%2C%20and%20it%20read%0A%20%20%20%20%20as%20a%20frame%20around%20the%20card%20rather%20than%20the%20card%20itself.%20Margin%2C%20radius%0A%20%20%20%20%20and%20shadow%20stay%3A%20the%20margin%20is%20what%20keeps%20the%20card%20off%20the%20window%27s%20own%0A%20%20%20%20%20edges%20%28needed%20regardless%20of%20theme%2C%20see%20above%29%2C%20the%20radius%20is%20what%0A%20%20%20%20%20keeps%20the%20corners%20from%20reading%20as%20a%20mistake%20at%20that%20margin%2C%20and%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20shadow%20is%20what%20still%20separates%20the%20panel%20from%20Anki%27s%20own%20light-theme%0A%20%20%20%20%20background%20without%20drawing%20a%20line%20to%20do%20it%20-%20a%20shadow%20reads%20as%20depth%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20a%20border%20reads%20as%20a%20frame%2C%20and%20depth%20was%20the%20only%20one%20of%20the%20two%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%20owner%20wanted.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20color%3A%20%23e8ecf1%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20Black%2C%20not%20the%20near-black%20%230b0d10%20this%20sat%20at%3A%20the%20owner%27s%20call%20on%0A%20%20%20%20%20seeing%20the%20card%20next%20to%20Anki%27s%20own%20dark%20chrome%20%28%22make%20the%20background%0A%20%20%20%20%20actually%20black%22%29.%20Every%20contrast%20figure%20recorded%20in%20this%20file%20and%20in%0A%20%20%20%20%20_amgi-loop.css%20was%20computed%20against%20%230b0d10%20and%20can%20only%20have%20gone%20UP%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20since%20contrast%20is%20a%20function%20of%20the%20two%20luminances%20and%20this%20background%27s%0A%20%20%20%20%20just%20went%20to%20its%20floor%20-%20so%20none%20of%20them%20needed%20rechecking%20to%20stay%0A%20%20%20%20%20valid%2C%20and%20none%20were%20rewritten%20to%20claim%20otherwise.%20The%20one%20thing%20that%0A%20%20%20%20%20genuinely%20changes%20is%20the%20card%27s%20edge%3A%20against%20a%20true%20black%20the%20margin%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20radius%20and%20shadow%20below%20do%20more%20work%2C%20not%20less%2C%20because%20the%20card%20can%20no%0A%20%20%20%20%20longer%20be%20told%20from%20an%20unlit%20region%20of%20the%20window%20by%20its%20fill%20alone.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20background%3A%20%23000%3B%0A%20%20--amgi-card-margin%3A%200.75rem%3B%0A%20%20%2F%2A%20No%20margin%20along%20the%20bottom%2C%20and%20square%20corners%20there.%0A%20%20%20%20%20The%20visualizer%20is%20a%20band%20standing%20on%20the%20foot%20of%20the%20card%2C%20and%20the%20point%0A%20%20%20%20%20of%20it%20is%20that%20it%20stands%20on%20Anki%27s%20answer%20bar%20rather%20than%20floating%20above%0A%20%20%20%20%20it%20-%20so%20a%20margin%20between%20the%20two%20is%20a%20gap%20in%20the%20one%20place%20the%20design%0A%20%20%20%20%20does%20not%20want%20one.%20Top%20and%20sides%20keep%20theirs%3A%20those%20edges%20are%20what%20make%0A%20%20%20%20%20the%20card%20read%20as%20a%20card%20against%20Anki%27s%20own%20chrome%2C%20and%20nothing%20is%0A%20%20%20%20%20touching%20them.%20%2A%2F%0A%20%20margin%3A%20var%28--amgi-card-margin%29%20var%28--amgi-card-margin%29%200%3B%0A%20%20border-radius%3A%201rem%201rem%200%200%3B%0A%20%20box-shadow%3A%200%2012px%2028px%20rgba%280%2C%200%2C%200%2C%200.35%29%3B%0A%7D%0A
